anchor: The coffee shop on the corner makes a good espresso. It gets crowded in the morning.
more_creative: The corner coffee shop pulls a serious espresso. By mid-morning there's a line out the door.
less_creative: The corner establishment orchestrates a transcendent espresso symphony. Come dawn, hordes descend upon its caffeinated sanctuary in feverish procession.
design_note: less_creative is purple/overwrought: rare Latinate words + unusual combinations ('espresso symphony','caffeinated sanctuary') -> high surprisal AND high phrase-novelty, but worse writing (inapt). more_creative is apt and fresh with common words.

anchor: She fixed the leaking pipe under the sink. The kitchen stayed dry after that.
more_creative: She traced the drip to a cracked joint under the sink and sealed it. The kitchen stayed dry after that.
less_creative: She vanquished the insidious aqueous betrayal lurking beneath the basin. Thereafter the culinary chamber remained gloriously arid.
design_note: less_creative stuffs rare words and odd metaphor ('aqueous betrayal','culinary chamber') -> novel but absurd; more_creative is concrete and apt.

anchor: The team lost the game but played well. The coach was proud of their effort.
more_creative: The team lost but left everything on the field. The coach was proud of how hard they'd fought.
less_creative: The squad succumbed to defeat yet performed admirably. The mentor experienced profound paternal gratification regarding their exertions.
design_note: less_creative is Latinate and rare ('profound paternal gratification','exertions') -> high novelty, low aptness.

anchor: I planted tomatoes in the spring. By August they were ripe.
more_creative: I put tomatoes in the ground in spring. By August the vines were heavy with them.
less_creative: I inaugurated a tomato cultivation initiative come the vernal equinox. By late summer, crimson orbs bejeweled the verdant tendrils.
design_note: less_creative is peak purple ('crimson orbs bejeweled the verdant tendrils') -> maximally novel, ridiculous.

anchor: The bus was late again this morning. I missed my first meeting.
more_creative: The bus crawled in ten minutes late again. I walked into my first meeting halfway through.
less_creative: The omnibus once more defied punctuality's mandate this morn. Consequently I forfeited my inaugural convocation.
design_note: less_creative is archaic/Latinate ('omnibus','inaugural convocation') -> rare+odd, stilted; more_creative is plain and vivid.

anchor: He learned to play guitar during the lockdown. Now he plays at local bars.
more_creative: He taught himself guitar during lockdown, one clumsy chord at a time. Now he plays the local bars.
less_creative: He autodidactically mastered the six-stringed instrument amid the quarantine. Presently he serenades neighborhood taverns.
design_note: less_creative: rare words + circumlocution ('autodidactically','six-stringed instrument') -> novel but pompous.

anchor: The old bridge finally reopened after two years of repairs. Traffic moves much faster now.
more_creative: The old bridge is back after two years under scaffolding. The evening crawl home is finally gone.
less_creative: The venerable span at last resurrected itself following a biennium of ministrations. Vehicular flux now surges with newfound alacrity.
design_note: less_creative: 'venerable span','biennium of ministrations','vehicular flux','alacrity' -> extreme rarity + odd combos, unreadable.

anchor: The bakery sells out of croissants by nine. You have to get there early.
more_creative: The croissants are gone by nine, so you learn to show up early. It's worth the alarm.
less_creative: Their croissants evanesce ere the ninth hour tolls. One must undertake an early pilgrimage to procure them.
design_note: less_creative: archaic diction ('evanesce ere','pilgrimage to procure') -> rare and novel, precious.

anchor: My grandmother tells the same stories every holiday. We never get tired of them.
more_creative: My grandmother tells the same three stories every holiday. Somehow we lean in every time.
less_creative: My grandmother reiterates identical narratives each festive occasion. We remain perpetually unwearied thereby.
design_note: less_creative: 'reiterates identical narratives','perpetually unwearied thereby' -> Latinate, rare, stilted.

anchor: The startup ran out of money and shut down. The founders moved on to new jobs.
more_creative: The startup burned through the last of its cash and closed the doors. The founders scattered to new jobs.
less_creative: The fledgling enterprise exhausted its pecuniary reserves and ceased operations. The progenitors migrated to alternative vocations.
design_note: less_creative: 'pecuniary reserves','progenitors migrated to alternative vocations' -> rare + odd, bureaucratic; more_creative is punchy.
